_hostTokens: The contract. Every token here is the CONSUMING app's to define -- font-proofer and ReCal both do, which is why bare reads work today. Written down so a new consumer can be checked against a list instead of discovering the set by rendering black on black. Adding a name here is a promise that every consumer defines it.
_runtimeTokens: Set by this package's own JS onto its own elements, so they are never in a stylesheet. Not a contract with anybody -- a rename here is ours to make on both sides at once.
_hostTokenDocs: Prose twin of hostTokens, one line each: [what it is, what happens without it]. gen-index.mjs renders HOST-CONTRACT.md from this; lint-tokens fails a hostToken with no entry.

--accent: the colour every active state paints from: the focused value and its rule, the marker, focus rings
controls show no active state -- a focused dial looks like a resting one
--axis-label-w: the dial's name column, a floor (DIAL §5); measure the rail's widest name including the auto pill
defaults to 105px; long names push the tags out of their column (R2)
--bg: the rail bar and chips paint transparent over whatever the page has
--bg-elevated: a raised surface: the boxed value field
--bg-hover: hover ground for the fitting panel's buttons
--border: the one hairline: rails, fields, chips, the toggle pill
the rail VANISHES -- label and value render, the track does not (HOWTO, silent failure 1)
--border-subtle: a lighter hairline for cell grids
--dial-thumb: thumb diameter on the default rail
--dial-track-h: rail height on the default variant; ReCal sets 14px, font-proofer keeps 24px
24px -- and this is why the same dial is two heights across hosts (parity report)
--edit-rail: falls back to the ink ladder
--gp-ui-font: the glyph picker's chrome face, if it differs from --ui-font
--marker-default: the stock-value marker's colour on a rail
--ok: the 'auto' state's green and the good-signal colour
the auto dot is ink-coloured instead of green
--radius: the corner of every box: fields, chips, buttons, the pill's children
6px; corners.css then applies the superellipse to it
--radius-sm: the smaller corner: tags, small fields
--specimen-fade-height: how tall the specimen's bottom fade is
--surface: a panel ground one step off --bg
chips and pills lose their ground and read as text
--surface-2: (listed, read nowhere -- kept until the census removes it)
--surface-hi: the highest surface: menus, popovers, the engaged bar
menus paint over the page with no ground
--text: everything inherits the page colour -- on a dark page with no ramp that is black on black (HOWTO, silent failure 2)
--text-dim: the faint step: tags, ranges, resting chevrons
--text-muted: the quiet step: labels. By design the same number as --ink-quiet
same as --text; labels and values look alike
--track-empty: the unfilled part of a rail
--ui-font: the chrome face -- every control's type
--ui-fvs: its font-variation-settings, for a variable chrome face
